lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The patrol is broken. In the keep, the big man's sword lies where it fell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When {mc} reaches for it, the blade is cold, and heavier than any iron should be. It will not lift.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: It chose him. It will wait for the next fool.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: We bury him. Then we go south, to {town}. We need a forge and a market.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They make camp in the lee of the ruin, and nobody sleeps much.
